Instead, the Planner incorrectly shifted focus to Lindsey (Mercian sphere) based on an unfounded boundary inference and prematurely concluded the dialect was Mercian, contradicting both the source snippet and the question’s reference to the northern Anglian kingdom near the Humber (i.e., Northumbria/Deira).
